notes.title: Updated demo / shared saves
notes.content: Now supporting steam cloud save.  Also a new demo build so it doesn't get behind

notes.title: Now with Icons
notes.content: Super cleaned up the layout of the resource views.  Also a couple of miscellaneous fixes: A crash, autobuy sand being enabled always, etc.

notes.title: Rebalance forest intro
notes.content: The play experience from unlocking forest to getting a sustainable source of leaf particles was way too long, and required too much clicking.  It is now much shorter and more pleasant to experience.

notes.title: Windowing update
notes.content: You can now exit full screen

notes.title: Upgrade number display
notes.content: Now numbers always take up a maximum of 5 digits
